scientific_limitations: Finite fields of characteristic at least five only.
Period dividing six; exact order six is the main count.
Only the three-dimensional Heisenberg Lie algebra, not higher-dimensional analogues.
Finite enumerations check only five prime fields and do not establish the general statement.
Bounded literature comparisons cannot certify priority.
title: The orbit census of period-six derivations of the three-dimensional Heisenberg Lie algebra
